Aurelia is probably one of the best instructors to take HUM111/112 from. Her choice of texts is interesting; she clearly states what the objective is, and she builds the topic of the course throughout the semester with relevant passages. Also, she is an understanding person who listens and tries to help her students as much as she can, and you can feel that effort. While taking this course, you can actually feel you are becoming better at close reading and argument generating. Her feedback to texts is informative, and you can easily communicate with her to get more detailed feedback.

Her strongest point is to have showed up consistently and done the coursework. 

Her weakest point is to lack respect for her students by ignoring their views, underestimating their abilities and ignoring the effort they put into the course. We completed her online assignment and despite turnitin or any other AI detector saying that our assignments are not done by AI, she gave us 0 points and told us that she doesnt believe that the texts we wrote represents our level. As a student who has been awarded a bilingual diploma in the past, who also has been consistently writing high level English essays throughout high school education, I am disappointed to see how easy it was for someone to ignore the time and effort I put into the assignment. It makes no sense for a student to prove to their instructor that they completed the assignment themselves. In the technology age where the university provides online tools that detect plagiarism, it is her responsibility to justify her claim. Yet, as she threatens to take the matter to the disciplinary committee in case we object, we did not want to risk our scholarships and backed out. This is yet another behavior that is very unfair to students. Due to this incident, myself and many friends from her section will get low grades and will retake this course - definitely from another instructor. She has taken a semester of time, effort and points from us. This is the first time I am filling the evaluation form of an instructor in such negative way. Bilkent needs instructors that care about students and respects them, not ones that ignore and disrespect them. It is also heartbreaking to have been blocked to object to this situation by being indirectly threatened with our scholarships, hence I want to point it out to your attention that this instructor is not obeying the university's policy for plagiarism and forces the students to admit to something they have not done.

While there are people who are expected to write a short essay including the topics and ideas discussed in the lecture, it is not fair to expect certain students to decide which prompt to use, then which texts to use, then create a non-cliche argument, then create at least four sub-claims, then which evidence to make close reading, and then write a four pages long comparative essay in only 2 hours.
